# Agatha Sowerby

- **Age:** Elderly  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c9 P45](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0045)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000)</sub>
- **Status:** Widowed  <sub>[v2 c26 P2](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0002)</sub>
- **Origin:** Brierley  <sub>[v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000), [v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001)</sub>
- **Role:** Homemaker and community organizer  <sub>[v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001)</sub>
- **Titles:** Mrs.  <sub>[v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000)</sub>; Mrs. Agatha Sowerby  <sub>[v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000)</sub>; Mrs. Agatha  <sub>[v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000)</sub>

## Appearance

Mrs. Agatha Sowerby is a stout, heavy woman who waddles when she walks and weighs roughly two hundred pounds. She watches over the main thoroughfare in Brierley from her kitchen window while knitting cotton warp quilts.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000), [v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v1 c9 P30](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0030), [v1 c10 P38](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0038), [v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006)_

## Personality

Mrs. Agatha Sowerby is an energetic, proficient homemaker and busybody who takes strict interest in the affairs of her neighbors. She prides herself on speaking her mind candidly, fearlessly, and forcefully without dread or partiality. Though meddlesome, intrusive, and critical of unconventional behavior or foreign novelties, she possesses a kind, compassionate heart and is always willing to help those in need.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v1 c1 P24](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0024), [v1 c9 P0](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0000), [v1 c9 P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014), [v1 c9 P45](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0045), [v1 c10 P1](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0001), [v1 c10 P33](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0033), [v1 c10 P38](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0038), [v2 c6 P8](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0008), [v2 c9 P0](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0000), [v2 c9 P10](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0010)_

## History

Mrs. Agatha Sowerby lived in Sowerby's Hollow in Brierley, watching the road through her kitchen window. When Obed Abernethy dressed in his finest clothes on a busy June afternoon, Agatha investigated and discovered that the Abernethys were adopting an orphan. After Nell Harcourt arrived and proved to be a girl rather than the expected boy, Agatha visited Grey Shutters and insulted Nell's freckles and red hair, causing Nell to fly into a furious rage. Nell later apologized, and Agatha readily forgave her. Over the following years, Agatha maintained her prominent role in Brierley society, organizing events like the Sunday-school picnic ice cream and the Church Aid Society bazaar. Though she originally doubted Nell's upbringing, Agatha came to admire Nell's cleverness and transformation into an attractive young woman. When her husband Thomas fell ill and passed away, Agatha faced financial hardship due to a farm mortgage and medical debts. Thirza Abernethy invited Agatha to live at Grey Shutters in the north gable, allowing Nell to pursue her college education at Wexcombe while Agatha kept Thirza company.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000), [v1 c1 P3](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0003), [v1 c1 P5](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0005), [v1 c1 P16](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0016), [v1 c9 P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014), [v1 c9 P16](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0016), [v1 c10 P30](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0030), [v1 c10 P34](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0034), [v1 c10 P38](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0038), [v1 c13 P2](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0002), [v2 c14 P4](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0004), [v2 c26 P0](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0000), [v2 c26 P11](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0011), [v2 c26 P15](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0015), [v2 c26 P21](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0021), [v2 c26 P27](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0027)_

## Background by volume

- Raised ten children and buried two  <sub>[v1 c9 P30](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0030)</sub>
- Had red hair in her youth that turned auburn as she matured  <sub>[v1 c10 P34](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0034)</sub>
- Directed the Brierley Sewing Circle, Sunday-school, Church Aid Society, and Foreign Missions Auxiliary  <sub>[v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001)</sub>
- Mortgaged her farm to help her youngest son start a business in the West  <sub>[v2 c26 P11](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0011)</sub>

## Quotes

> She’s awfully thin and plain, Thirza. Step over this way, child, so I can inspect you. Goodness gracious, has anyone ever witnessed such freckles? And hair that is as red as carrots!  <sub>[v1 c9 P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014)</sub>

> Was such a temper ever witnessed by anyone!  <sub>[v1 c9 P21](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0021)</sub>

> No one can dispute that your hair is exceedingly red; nevertheless, I used to know a female—we actually attended school together—who possessed hair precisely as red as yours in her youth, yet it deepened into a truly lovely auburn as she matured.  <sub>[v1 c10 P34](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0034)</sub>

> I’m not feeling discouraged... when my mind is made up to do something, it remains made up.  <sub>[v1 c9 P12](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0012)</sub>

> I simply reckon she has succeeded, and I would certainly not hold back from stating as much. You bring honor to your companions, Nell, indeed you do, and every one of us is proud of you.  <sub>[v1 c32 P48](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0048)</sub>

- Spouse of — Agatha dominated and managed Thomas, though she cared for him devotedly during his final illness until his death.  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v2 c22 P9](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0009), [v2 c26 P0](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0000)</sub>

### Thirza Abernethy

- Friend of — Close friend and longtime neighbor of over forty-five years who eventually invited Agatha to move into Grey Shutters.  <sub>[v1 c1 P12](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0012), [v2 c26 P15](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0015), [v2 c26 P21](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0021)</sub>
